title: Supreme Court Declines Voting Rights Act Enforcement Fight Ahead of 2026 Midterms
detail: The Supreme Court declined to take up a dispute over Voting Rights Act enforcement, avoiding a major election-law ruling ahead of the 2026 midterm elections. The Court's decision to pass on the case leaves existing enforcement frameworks intact for now, though the underlying legal questions around the VRA remain unresolved and could return to the Court in a future term.
